name: 00-identity
sql: select current_user as api_role, current_database() as db, (select setting from pg_settings where name='server_version') as server_version, (select setting from pg_settings where name='server_version_num') as server_version_num, now() as captured_at_utc, pg_current_wal_lsn()::text as current_wal_lsn, pg_walfile_name(pg_current_wal_lsn()) as current_wal_file
